priorities.summary: An integer overflow when compiling a specially crafted regular expression lets an unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary code on self-managed GitLab CE/EE, affecting all versions from 7.0 (2014) up to the fixed releases. There is no workaround: upgrade to 19.5.1, 19.4.3, 19.3.6 or the other patched lines; GitLab.com is already fixed.

Missing authentication for a critical function in Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Configuration Service allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network, with no authentication or user interaction required.
Improper link resolution before file access ('link following') in VM Inspector for Azure Virtual Machines allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

model.name: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra
model.summary: OpenAI's fast everyday-work model, launched October 26, combines visual reasoning with precise computer use and clearer writing at 50% lower standard API prices than GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol. It is available in ChatGPT Work and Codex and via the API as gpt-6.1-terra, and OpenAI says it finishes tasks over 3x faster than GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol.
